# awscc_personalize_campaign (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Personalize::Campaign



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `campaign_arn` (String) The ARN of the campaign.
- `campaign_config` (Attributes) The configuration details of a campaign. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--campaign_config))
- `creation_date_time` (String) The time at which the campaign was created.
- `last_updated_date_time` (String) The time at which the campaign was last updated.
- `min_provisioned_tps` (Number) Specifies the requested minimum provisioned transactions per second.
- `name` (String) The name of the campaign.
- `solution_version_arn` (String) The ARN of the solution version to deploy.
- `status` (String) The status of the campaign.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags to associate with the campaign. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--campaign_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `campaign_config`

Read-Only:

- `enable_metadata_with_recommendations` (Boolean) Whether metadata with recommendations is enabled for the campaign.
- `item_exploration_config` (Map of String) Specifies the exploration configuration hyperparameters.
- `ranking_influence` (Map of Number) A map of ranking influence values for POPULARITY and FRESHNESS.
- `sync_with_latest_solution_version` (Boolean) Whether the campaign automatically updates to use the latest solution version.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.
